name: Scientist
hook: A teenager who started out repairing King Tubby's electronics ended up in his engineer's chair, and gave dub its horror-movie phase.
blurb: Hopeton 'Overton' Brown, who took the name Scientist, started out around King Tubby's Waterhouse studio as a teenager in the mid-1970s, repairing equipment before he was allowed near the mixing desk. By the early 1980s he was one of Tubby's two lead engineers, alongside Prince Jammy: dub production was passing from Tubby himself to the next generation he had trained. Scientist mixed a run of dub albums with themed titles like 'Scientist Rids the World of the Evil Curse of the Vampires' (1981), built from rhythms recorded at Channel One by the Roots Radics band. They kept Tubby's mixing techniques alive for a new set of Kingston studios and bands after the scene's founding studios had moved on, and their horror and science-fiction themes packaged an established sound as a recognisable brand.
